name: esoul
description: eSoul's Claude workspace: the eSoul skills with the optional worker agents and hooks, and the third-party plugins the eSoul workflow relies on. The rest of the third-party layers is installed with `npx @esoul-cz/skills install`.

plugins.name: esoul-skills
plugins.description: eSoul's own skills in layers (core, dev, project, helpers, business), including the esoul-workflow entry point, plus optional worker agents and hooks.

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's skill set. The eSoul skills build on its code-review, tdd, diagnosing-bugs, grilling, handoff, prototype, codebase-design and domain-modeling skills. Upstream, updates from the author.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Anthropic's frontend-design skill for distinctive, non-templated UI. Upstream, updates from Anthropic.
